title_sq: Okazion! Dyqan ne shitje te Xhamlliku
description_sq: Te ish Profarma, disponojme per shitje 2 Dyqane me siperfaqe respektive 68.09 m2 dhe 77.47 m2, kati zero, te perfunduar. Dyqanet jane ngjit me njeri tjetrin dhe mund te bashkohen ne nje te vetem me siperfaqe me te madhe. Shitet te ndare ose te 2 se bashku sipas kerkesave te klienteve. Shiten me cmim kleringu 2000 euro/m2.
title_en: Opportunity! Shop for sale in Xhamlliku
description_en: In the former Profarma, we have for sale 2 shops with respective surface areas of 68.09 m2 and 77.47 m2, ground floor, finished. The stores are adjacent to each other and can be combined into one with a larger area. Sold separately or 2 together according to customer requests. They are sold at a clearing price of 2000 euros/m2.
